scripts.prepare:workspace: node scripts/generate-locales.mjs && pnpm protocol:generate && pnpm --filter @learning/protocol build && pnpm --filter @learning/client build
scripts.dev: pnpm prepare:workspace && concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm --filter @learning/api dev" "pnpm --filter @learning/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm prepare:workspace && pnpm --filter @learning/api build && pnpm --filter @learning/web build && pnpm --filter @learning/desktop build
